figure.title: Four HeLa cells expressing the calcium sensor Yellow Cameleon 3.60, coloured by YFP/CFP ratio (warm = high calcium), outlined and tracked with spaCR, with each tracked cell's calcium trace oscillating after histamine and stopping after pyrilamine
figure.note: Shows the method McFadden et al. used spaCR for (segment and track cells over time, quantify single-cell calcium oscillations), not their data. Data: Mahlandt EK, Arts JJG, Goedhart J (2021) Example data from timelapse fluorescence imaging experiments, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4501412, YCaM.zip, CC BY 4.0. Cellpose (cpsam) via spacr.utils._choose_model on every 4th frame, CPU; linked with spaCR's trackpy helper spacr.timelapse._facilitate_trackin_with_adaptive_removal; frame 46 of 121 shown.
